profile.headline: Backend software engineer focused on high performance applications
profile.summary: I am a software engineer based in Chicago Illinois. I have worked on fullstack and backend applications. A majority of my work has been designing systems that have to maximize CPU, memory, screen real estate, and  also be intuitive to users. I like engaging with passionate teams, who want to push themselves to solve complex problems efficiently. I specialize in object-oriented programming, concurrent and asynchronous architectures, event based user applications, distributed systems, and  leveraging performance out of operating systems. The coding languages I specialize in are C#, C++, and Java. I received a Bachelors of Science in Computer Science from the Paul G Allen School of Computer Science at University of Washington Seattle Campus.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Working on the back-end of trading applications. Using C# 8 with asp.net 7.
positions.insights: Skills: Software Infrastructure · Software Design · Engineering · Software Industry · Web Engineering

positions.title: Junior Software Engineer
positions.description: Works on the desktop UI/UX team on Full-Stack development. Create responsive desktop applications traders use to interact in real-time with financial markets. Applications need to take in large amounts of data, display only relevant information while filtering out the noise. Team creates and manages several applications, which need to minimize overhead and real-estate while also being useful for traders. On the team I specialized in backend performance, making sure that the business logic runs concurrently while the user interacts with the application. I also focused on debugging elusive race conditions that could either slow down our applications over time, cause unintended user actions, or totally crash our applications. I worked with several different teams in the firm to work on cross-team ventures, with focusing on clear and concise communication to maximize efficency.
positions.insights: Skills: Bash · Cross-team Collaboration · Jira · User Experience Design (UED) · Debugging · C# · Full-Stack Development · Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) · Software Architectural Design · Cross-team Communication · Market Making
